input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term"). Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: Renewal term length is acceptable (successive 1-year, not multi-year), but the only exit route after the Initial Term is a ninety (90) day notice, which exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal window and so fails the fallback on a material term (it is at, not beyond, the 90-day walk-away line). Redline shortens the notice to thirty (30) days and confirms it may be exercised as a non-renewal election, offering 60 days as fallback. Pricing is a revenue share set in the Exhibits with no unilateral uplift mechanic, so the CPI/3% cap is not engaged; the absence of a vendor renewal reminder is a minor sub-element only and is not separately flagged.

proposal.summary: Shorten post-Initial-Term termination/non-renewal notice from 90 days to 30 days
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms but our only exit requires ninety (90) days' notice, which exceeds our 30-day preferred (60-day fallback) non-renewal window, so we have shortened it to thirty (30) days. We can live with sixty (60) days if that is easier for you.

ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement, or elect not to renew the then-current Term, for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party.
